blocking_conditions: no physical VR controller event source

controller_and_recorder.action_format: absolute end-effector position (3), quaternion orientation (4), gripper {-1,+1} from VR analogue trigger

prospective_collection_design.start_state_sampling: native CALVIN scene reset; record exact robot_obs and scene_obs
prospective_collection_design.success_failure_recording: new_playtable_tasks Tasks.get_task_info_for_set from start/end info; retain both outcomes
prospective_collection_design.termination_rule: operator ends after task attempt and at least 160 recorded frames
